## Monster Beverage Sales Rise 16.7% to $2.56 Billion


[Per Monster's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000865752/000110465926123387/tm2629095d1_ex99-1.htm) , net sales rose 16.7% to a record $2.56 billion and adjusted EPS was $0.30, while gross margin eased to 54.7% from 55.7% a year earlier. Investing.com reported that EPS matched analyst expectations and sales topped the $2.49 billion consensus, but did not cite a reason for the after-hours decline.


## Celsius Posts Record $847.2 Million Revenue as Gross Margin Narrows


Celsius reported record quarterly revenue of $847.2 million, up 16.8%, and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.41 versus $0.42 a year earlier,[per its release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001341766/000134176626000059/ex9913q2026.htm) , with gross margin down to 46.8% from 51.3%.[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/11/05/celsius-flagship-slips-6-as-alani-nu-grows-rapid-earnings-reaction/) linked the margin decline to higher aluminum and fuel costs and more volume moving through PepsiCo's store delivery system, and reported Alani Nu revenue up about 24% while the CELSIUS brand fell about 6%. Shares rose about 5% in pre-market trading, per the same report.


## SoundHound Guides 2027 Revenue to $350 Million to $400 Million


[According to SoundHound AI's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001840856/000184085626000025/soun-20261105ex991earnings.htm) , revenue rose 48.5% to $62.4 million and the GAAP net loss was $46.4 million. The company guided 2026 revenue to $250 million to $260 million and 2027 revenue to $350 million to $400 million, and expects sustained adjusted EBITDA profitability within the second half of 2027. Seeking Alpha reported that investors focused on the ongoing losses and the profitability timeline.


## Krispy Kreme Raises 2026 Revenue Guidance to $1.35 Billion to $1.40 Billion


Krispy Kreme's net revenue fell 12.4% to $328.8 million, while adjusted EPS rose to $0.06 from $0.01,[per the company's release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001857154/000185715426000049/exh991q3pressrelease2026.htm) . It lifted its 2026 net revenue outlook to $1.35 billion to $1.40 billion, from $1.25 billion to $1.35 billion. "We made significant progress on our turnaround in the third quarter," said CEO Josh Charlesworth.


## Sony Lifts Fiscal 2026 Operating Income Forecast to ¥1,870 Billion


Sony Group's fiscal second-quarter sales rose 10% to ¥3,429.4 billion and operating income jumped 45% to ¥622.3 billion,[according to its Form 6-K filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000313838/000110465926122964/tm2628525d5_6k.htm) . It raised its full-year operating income forecast to ¥1,870 billion from ¥1,720 billion and its sales forecast to ¥13,000 billion from ¥12,500 billion, naming Pictures and Game and Network Services as the main contributors.
